topic: API v3 report structure and changes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on understanding the output of a specific API endpoint (`report-v3`) and its data structure. A user questioned why the 'unique' count appeared identical to the 'bulk' count in many instances, especially when querying by `facility` at an hourly granularity.

Multiple requests were made for comprehensive documentation beyond simple Swagger specifications, specifically requesting a release note or diff detailing which fields were removed or changed in version 3 of the API.
